turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = b1 * (b2+x)**(-1/b3) to the data in bennett5.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = -2000, b2 = 50, b3 = 0.8. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Bennett5 (public domain), data copied verbatim
